nodes.label: Adaptive Per-Shot Depth Script v2 (pro treatment)
nodes.rationale: v2 pro treatment adds depth-matched cuts (placement shifted so convergence feels continuous across scene cuts, unlike v1 which re-centered the depth budget each cut), a comfort budget with clamp flags, capped close-up pop-out (placement upper <= 0.1), and dynamic-shot per-keyframe ramps. Each *_depth_script.json is the per-shot decision log with an adjustments list naming every intervention.

nodes.label: ProPainter Stereo Conversion Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Production pipeline stages visible in job timings: preprocess -> profile_scenes -> chunked video_stereo[propainter] (both-eye inpainting, VDA depth) -> encode_outputs -> encode_mvhevc_x265; outputs sbs + mvhevc, audio muxed from source.
